forensics.finding: Hedgeys vesting contract released 136.0M SIREN (18.8% of supply, ~$251M) to ~49 wallets on 2026-03-22 09:13-10:56 UTC, 2 days before the peak; price fell 57% the day after the peak.
forensics.lesson: A large vesting release to many fresh wallets right before a top is an exit-now trigger.

forensics.finding: 13 outside wallets deposited 3.05M VELVET ($4.54M, 0.30% of supply) to Gate on Jun 29-Jul 1; three unlabeled wallets deposited 412K/457K/419K within 5 minutes on Jul 1 05:17-05:22 UTC, 2 days before the drop.
forensics.lesson: Several wallets depositing similar amounts to one exchange within minutes = coordinated sell prep.

forensics.finding: A wallet labeled 'Hypersphere Ventures' moved 5.50M STONK to an intermediate wallet that forwarded it to Gate 29 minutes later ($1.51M, ~0.6% of supply) on Sep 27, 6 days after the closing peak; 5 outside->CEX deposits totaled $2.97M Sep 18-27.
forensics.lesson: Fund/VC wallets routing tokens to an exchange through a fresh hop is distribution.

forensics.finding: Biggest seller in Sep 13-25 was 'Stonk: Rewards Distributor' ($778K sold, net 96.5M tokens, ~9.7% of supply); 'Pablo Token Deployer' sold $194K (net 16.4M, ~1.6%); a wallet funded with 17.6M tokens on peak day sold $287K.
forensics.lesson: Reward/treasury/deployer wallets selling into a run cap the upside; treat as dev selling.

forensics.finding: Little on-chain selling: the top DEX seller was an MEV bot (net 0.10% of supply); 92 of 95 exchange transfers were exchange-internal (Gate/Bitget/KuCoin) from Jun 28; a team multisig burned 10M LAB (1.0%) on collapse day; 7.99M LAB ($9.0M) went to the Astherus perp deposit vault after the collapse.
forensics.lesson: When price collapses without on-chain sellers, the selling is on CEX/perps: on-chain 'all clear' is not safety for CEX-listed low-float tokens.
